scientific_comparisons.native_curve_scope: Original Static_Analysis full V arrays for official, changedT, changedPO2, and changedN/R/lambda; zero-current behavior retained.
scientific_comparisons.calibration: Recovered R=0.002 ohm and lambda=18 on 20 training and 5 held-out source-generated points. Corrupting only held-out responses leaves the fitted parameters unchanged. Whole-group IDs 001 and 1 remain distinct. Both raw and column-normalized Jacobian diagnostics are retained; no parameter confidence intervals are invented.
scientific_comparisons.replicate_comparison: B minus A effects, 95% confidence intervals and p-values agree with independent SciPy paired and Welch calculations on actual replicate aggregates. Shuffling rows or copying within-replicate samples preserves inference. Missing pairs fail; constant contrasts have no manufactured p-value or interval.
scientific_comparisons.power_accounting: Derived electrical quantities agree with supplied current, voltage and auxiliary powers. Missing powers are not imputed. Fan-only subtraction is not labeled full net power. Selected Excel sheets and text IDs are preserved; source files are unchanged.
scientific_comparisons.lhs: Each variable has one point in every one of 8 strata, plus 3 center repeats. Execution order is randomized, the seed reproduces the design, and calls use new output directories.
scientific_comparisons.sensitivity: Independently recomputed all 160 ordered original-model responses. SALib first-order, total-order and confidence estimates agree with direct API calls at 1e-12 tolerance. A 4096-base Ishigami benchmark matches analytic indices within 0.025. Zero output variance fails rather than returning fake zero indices.
scientific_comparisons.optuna: Optuna 5 Trial.set_constraint preserves all 16 completed records, including infeasible observations. Three pending candidates have no invented outcomes and satisfy input bounds. Seed replay is deterministic; 4 history rows are labeled random startup. Candidate outcome feasibility is never claimed.
scientific_comparisons.literature: Tested DOI case deduplication, explicit access levels, HTTP errors and empty results with controlled responses. A separate real Crossref MCP call returned 2 metadata records with full_text_reviewed=false. Patent output contains encoded search links and an unchecked matrix; no live search or novelty verdict is claimed.

limitations: These checks establish selected software behavior, not experimental validation of user hardware. Example observations are explicitly synthetic.
Measured or prescribed temperature remains an input. Air-cooled heat/water dynamics and fan thermal control are not implemented.
Replicate independence and steady-state status are experimental-design assumptions supplied by the user; numeric screens cannot certify them.
Sobol analysis assumes independent uniform inputs within declared bounds. The indices are model-conditional, not causal proof.
Optuna candidates require measurements to establish outcome-constraint feasibility. No candidate power, temperature or novelty verdict is fabricated.
Crossref provides metadata and available abstracts; full text is not reviewed. Patent plans neither perform patent searches nor certify novelty.
Execution covers Linux and Python 3.12.14. In-process scientific and MCP checks passed; real stdio, fresh installation, actual ZIP relocation and UI checks remain parent-owned stages.
No fuel-cell formula was changed. Original v0.1 model code, server, runtime lock and usage instructions remain byte-identical.
